# Intel detector & pinpointer
## Intel detector A handheld scanner that finds your faction's active objectives in a radius — mission markers light up on the screen.
- The scanner has two modes: [color=#a4885c]short range[/color] (scans more often, smaller radius) and [color=#a4885c]long[/color] (reaches farther, updates less often). Switch depending on the task. - Activate it in hand or by clicking a placed scanner; it turns off when dropped. - Faction-safe: it only finds your team's objectives (or neutral ones), so it won't give your quests away to the enemy.
## Mission pinpointer Leads you to the active mission target — an arrow points the way.
- Updates regularly. - Only works for your team. - If there's no team mission, it switches to the global one — watch the arrow.
